name: Empathy Immersed
summary:
You are about to embark on a unique and powerful journey - one that brings you closer to understanding the daily lives of people with disabilities. As you move through this experience, your senses, movements, and perceptions will be altered to reflect the challenges they face. Every step, sound, and interaction has been designed to highlight the barriers, both visible and invisible, that individuals with disabilities often encounter.
